items.title: Lee Paige Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: I was backed up by Russ Davis, KMOX, Augusta.

ctx.x: Lee, how about the Freedom Train show?

Well, that was quite an experience that I had. I traveled with the Freedom Train show and I appeared here in New Orleans, Memphis, and St. Louis. And in St. Louis, I was very well received there on the banks of the Mississippi River where I appeared. I was only scheduled to do three songs and a dance. And I was so successful at the three songs and a dance. I had to do six songs and three dances that liked to kill me. The Post-Dispatch paper there wrote me up and said that I was the only one that woke the people…
Lee, didn't you play with Martha Ray a number of years ago at the Oriental Theater?
